name: Kusunoki Hiromi
source:
She's generally a nice person, but if she sees a girl she likes, she becomes a sadist who wants to bully her. She graduated from this very academy to university, and after graduating that, she was assigned to Eishun Gakuen as a Physics Teacher. This year, she'll be teaching at this school as a science teacher.

[Translated from in-game description]
